label: The cheaper L
subgoals: Sum the row-0 and far-column edge costs for the horizontal-first L
Sum the near-column and far-row edge costs for the vertical-first L
Keep the cheaper of the two

label: Adding Z shapes
subgoals: Sum the three segments of each HVH Z by its jog column
Sum the three segments of each VHV Z by its jog row
Take the minimum over all L and Z shapes

label: Bends as a cost
subgoals: Add one bend penalty to each L shape
Add two bend penalties to each Z shape
Compare the penalised costs and pick the minimum
